data.name: Lethargic
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Wonderful World! You will step into this open scene that combines fantasy and crisis. In the screen, there are quaint wooden houses, lush forests, and lush grasslands. The falling pink petals add romance, yet hide unknown challenges.

Core Objective: While evading dinosaurs, collect the same red - and - white spotted mushrooms as those in the lower left corner. The mushrooms are randomly distributed throughout the scene. They may be hidden in the grass by the house or in the open spaces in the forest, so you need to search carefully.

Crisis Challenges: Ferocious dinosaurs are the biggest threat. They will wander randomly in the scene. Once you enter their field of vision or get close to a certain range, the dinosaurs will chase you. If you are caught, the game fails. You need to make use of the terrain, such as circling around trees, hiding behind buildings, flexibly adjusting your route, and cleverly escaping the pursuit.

Operation and Experience: Explore the scene by moving the perspective, and complete the movement by clicking or dragging. Each time you pick up a mushroom, the score accumulates. Successfully evading dinosaurs also gives additional rewards. As the collection progresses, the frequency of dinosaurs appearing may increase, and the exploration range of the scene will expand. Let you immerse yourself in the exciting "hide - and - seek" and collection tasks, and experience the thrilling and fantasy adventure fun. Come and challenge to see how long you can last surrounded by mushroom shadows and how many mushrooms you can collect!

Game Operation Method

Movement = WASD
